metadata_limitations: The benchmark-run catalog checksum binds product ID, category ID, and product name, but not vendor, price, or category display name.
Vendor, price, and category display name are export-time metadata unless stronger historical evidence is produced.
The three service databases do not share one transaction snapshot; immutable run identity, ready publication state, counts, and hashes are the cross-service gate.
The controlled/generated event stream must not be described as observed customer behavior.
